result.quote: “You will see it with your own eyes,” replied Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it.”
result.reason: The key is supported: the officer will not eat the flour or barley. However, the broad question also permits the materially different answer that he will see the event with his own eyes. In addition, the window calls him an “officer,” not a captain. The question should specify what he will not do, or the key should include both parts of Elisha’s prediction.
